Supreme Court flags ten‑fold price gap in essential cancer drug

The Supreme Court expressed shock at a ten‑fold price difference for an essential cancer medicine, noting that a drug priced at Rs 2,700 was being sold for Rs 27,000 and describing the overpricing as a daylight robbery.
